Name: Mix and Matchmaker - Choose Your Own Rival Hearts
Author: kcspace
Description:
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]If you’ve ever wanted to see how your rarepair ships or crackships play out on screen, now you can! [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Mix and Matchmaker allows players to configure rival heart pairings however they’d like.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Featuring:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]Configurable couples[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Optional Poly Mode that allows players to see rival heart events even when dating/married to either partner in a pairing[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Configurable event cooldowns (that can also be turned off entirely!)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/148527238-1784907444.png[/img]

[size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is [i]highly [/i]recommended for setting pairs up easily.[/size]

[left][size=4]Only pair couples up [/size][color=#cc0000][size=5][b]once[/b][/size][/color][size=4][color=#ffffff].[/color] For example, if you want Shane to date Leah then you should select Leah in Shane's dropdown menu, or Shane in Leah's dropdown menu, [/size][b][color=#cc0000][size=5]but not both[/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=5].[/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=4] [/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffffff][size=4]Examples of how to set up couples:[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffffff][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/148527238-1784907629.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/left]
